items.title: Robinhood Stock And Other Financial Plays On Rising Cash Balances
items.summary: A brutal AI sell-off, sparked by political worries and forced deleveraging, has pushed many investors toward the safety of short-duration cash and money-market style products. That shift is not just a mood change; it can redirect fee pools and funding flows for financial firms that live on client cash.
